items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is scheduled to undergo an MRI on his ankle today after leaving the stadium Sunday in a walking boot following a first-half injury; he did not return.
items.why: Left in protective boot after sack; coach indicated possible return talks but held out second half.
items.implication: Availability for Week 5 vs ATL uncertain pending MRI; Huntley would start if out.
items.opportunity: Monitor for full practice participation; Ravens offense changes without dual-threat.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Lamar Jackson (ankle), Ja'Marr Chase (concussion)/Tee Higgins (adductor), Saquon Barkley (hamstring), Rashee Rice (hamstring)/Tyquan Thornton (ankle), Ladd McConkey (foot aggravation), DJ Moore (shoulder), others.
items.implication: Multiple star absences possible Week 5; monitor practices.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and backups rise in value.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase ruled OUT due to concussion after facemask tackle and head hit in second quarter; finishes with 3-27.
items.why: Evaluated for concussion after hard hit; did not return.
items.implication: Enters concussion protocol; availability Week 5 vs MIA depends on clearing steps.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining WRs if he misses time.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley downgraded to OUT with hamstring injury after early exit on a run; only 2 carries for 8 yards.
items.why: Pulled up hobbling on first-quarter run, went to tent then locker room; already managing prior stinger.
items.implication: Risk of missing Week 5; hamstring strains often multi-week for RBs.
items.opportunity: Backfield opportunity expands for remaining RBs if he sits.

items.text: Bengals WR Tee Higgins suffered adductor injury late in game after big day (11-157); both top WRs banged up.
items.why: Injured on catch in final minutes; tried to return but could not continue.
items.implication: Severity unknown; could miss time compounding Chase absence.
items.opportunity: If both out, volume to other pass-catchers and Chase Brown.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful with hamstring tweak; will use bye to recover.
items.why: Hamstring injury during game; left early.
items.implication: Bye week recovery expected; monitor for post-bye return.
items.opportunity: Other KC WRs elevated short-term; Thornton also out indefinitely.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active (despite foot/rib concerns); Derwin James inactive hamstring.
items.implication: Played through; watch for aggravation postgame.
items.opportunity: Full routes if no limit, but ETR bigger dock.

items.text: Add Lamar to Saquon, Chase, DJ Moore and Mariota among players leaving games early.
items.implication: Immediate fantasy zeros or reduced; ROS risk.

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin) as Rams intend no workload limit per Schefter; tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring) no hard pitch count; bigger docks on Ladd McConkey (foot/ribs) and Mike Evans (ribs). Projecting Kenyon Sadiq in.
items.why: Schefter no-limit on Nacua; beat reports on Flowers; usage/injury severity for others.
items.implication: Nacua near full projection upgrade; McConkey/Evans more limited.
items.opportunity: Nacua/Flowers high opportunity without pitch counts.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: EXPECTED TO PLAY Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears; GTD/optimistic Mike Evans; NOT EXPECTED Terry McLaurin, Jalen Coker, Keenan Allen; Tyson Bagent starting.
items.why: Compiled from reports; McConkey confirmed active later.
items.implication: Nacua/Flowers/McConkey viable starts with docks; McLaurin sit.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full roles for expected players.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams: boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role uncertainty who ends up starting and crushing.
items.why: Role solidified, production matching opportunity as mid-round value.
items.implication: Strong ROS start/hold; buy if available.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management limiting him despite not being injured (maintenance); wants more to help team, accepts coaches managing workload.
items.why: Player comments on limited second-half snaps in close game for freshness.
items.implication: Timeshare/role not full; lower floor until unrestricted.
items.opportunity: Monitor for expanded role if healthy/fresh.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns have been called back due to penalty.
items.implication: High red-zone involvement despite zero TDs; positive usage signal.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: RT Lane Johnson (personal), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion).
items.implication: Offense depleted; Hurts/remaining skill lower ceiling.
